testcase.name: Scenario: Change a pending Find value without replacing a listed criterion: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:577:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change a pending Find value without replacing a listed criterion ✔ Given the MCAD Software Find dialog lists Type equals Extrusion and OR Type equals Fillet ✔ And Type equals Extrusion is selected with And selected ✔ When the user chooses Hole in the Value list ✔ Then the Value field shows Hole and adds to list is enabled ✔ And the listed Extrusion and Fillet criteria remain unchanged ✔ When the user selects the Fillet criterion ✔ Then the controls show Type, equals, Fillet and Or ✔ When the user selects the Extrusion criterion ✔ Then the controls show Type, equals, Extrusion and And ✔ And adds to list is disabled ✔ When the user closes the Find dialog ✔ Then the part workspace is visible
